content.intro: This lesson covers Microsoft Entra and Identity Operations in the PowerShell learning path. It expands the supplied syllabus heading into an actionable draft with a visual, a worked example, and a short knowledge check.
content.why_it_matters: Enterprise tasks depend on service-specific modules, tenant permissions, network policies and API versions. Start with a documented read-only inventory, use approved least-privilege identities, test in a non-production tenant or sandbox, and re-check module compatibility before automating a change.
